purpose: Bounded first-party discovery and anonymous cadastral-service review for Kosti, Sudan.
assessment: The official Aqari site describes a national Sudanese property-registration service affiliated with the judiciary, including land-record review, search certificates, and subdivision workflows. The official NIC search result describes a Sudan Spatial Portal using WMS/WFS, but its project page was not retrievable over the checked TLS path. No Kosti-specific map/API service, schema, CRS, safe parcel ID, or geometry response was verified. The Aqari homepage exposed only service descriptions and public HTML/JavaScript; no anonymous parcel geometry route was identified. Login and credentialed flows were not used.
registryAssessment: National official land-registration services were evidenced, but no Kosti-local registry/cadastre/map/procedure was directly evidenced; registryFound remains null.
